name: ANSI/IEEE Gas flow switch form
aliases: IEEE Flow Switch Normally Open - Gas
summary: IEEE-library form of gas flow switch: a gas-flow switch changes contact state for a specified gas-flow condition.
description: This reference locates gas flow switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. A gas-flow switch changes contact state for a specified gas-flow condition. Its process connection and operating requirement belong in the equipment schedule as well as the control logic. The public library uses HFS11S20 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Do not substitute liquid-flow characteristics for the selected gas device. Gas-flow actuation is a process-specific input and is separate from the contact's electrical rating. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
